summary: FloraSetu brand identity re-test (iteration 24). action_items: OPTIONAL (not brand-blocking): fix React dev warning — replace `fetchPriority` prop on with lowercase `fetchpriority` (or gate on React 18+) in /app/apps/web/src/pages/PublicHomePage.tsx to silence console warnings on the public homepage.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix location is correct: adding `font-family: inherit` to .fs-logo__flora and .fs-logo__setu in components.css defeats the [class^='fs-'] utility in tokens.css cleanly. Consider raising specificity or moving typography reset to a scoped selector to prevent similar overrides on other brand-critical children.

SVG petal paths are geometrically clean: all three petals originate at (32,34) which is the arc crown apex; all control points have y<=34, so no petal can protrude below the bridge arc — geometry acceptance passes.
React dev warning: should be `fetchpriority` (lowercase) in JSX for React 18. Cosmetic but polluting console on homepage/login/privacy/terms.
